in_marathi.name: Babul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Babul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Root, foundation, elder, father. The name Babul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Baba’, meaning father, and ‘Rul’ meaning root or foundation. It is a name that signifies strength, stability, and protection.
